address: 100 chemin de la Chapelle, Villerest, 42300, France
bio: Flavour and special occasion indulgence depict this 18C property nestled in greenery. Diners are treated to contemporary cuisine in the salle des peintures hung with period paintings, or in the conservatory overlooking the park. The chef scours the countryside for premium produce like Chérier pigeon, matured seabass or high-quality blue lobster. Warm welcome and seamless service....
